en.bdb: The saints among the four varnas

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਵੇ ਪੀਲੇ ਪਾਨ ਹਹਿ ਓਇ ਵੇਲਹੁ ਤੁਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: saave peele paan heh oi velahu tuTai|

en.bdb: The betel leaves when plucked from the branch are of green and yellow colour.
The betel nut getting pie bald colour is plucked from the tree.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥ ਹੁਰੇਹੀ ਭੂਸਲੀ ਦੇ ਚਾਵਲ ਚੁਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: kath hurehee bhoosalee dhe chaaval chuTai|

en.bdb: The catechu is of brown colour and light and a pinch of it is used.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੂਨਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਦਹਿ ਪਥਰੁ ਕੁਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: choonaa dhisai ujalaa dheh pathar kuTai|

en.bdb: The lime is white and is burnt and thrashed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਚੀਚ ਵਹੁਟੈ।
verses.translit_en: aap gavai samai mil ra(n)g cheech vahuTai|

en.bdb: When losing their ego (they meet) they uniformally become of red colour.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਾਧ ਹਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਹ ਜੁਟੈ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: tiau chahu varanaa vich saadh han gurmukh muh juTai ||18||

en.bdb: Likewise are the saints, who adopting the qualifies of the four varnas, live in mutual love like gmmukhs, the Guru oriented.
